source_baseline: Davonium Technologies V38 full website source supplied in conversation
summary: Reference-inspired cinematic hero with lightweight feathered scene image derived from the existing concept artwork in the source package; mobile-first refinements, a robot-first welcome, seven distinct demo identities, clearer deep-indigo/light themes, and corrected deployment path handling.
scope: Preserves existing corporate pages, product/service/contact routes, QR sections, legal pages, documentation, PWA manifest, and navigation.
Global positioning covers websites, web apps, Android/mobile apps, software systems, and digital products for individuals and organisations worldwide.
First-visit welcome is robot-first, with spoken introduction remaining user-initiated and existing written answers retained in source.

Homepage and welcome use a low-weight, transparent-edge WebP robot-and-skyline scene derived from an existing supplied concept image. Dark pupil, blink-lid, mouth, and chest-glow overlays provide face/speech feedback; the compact floating assistant uses transparent vector artwork.
Deep indigo/cobalt dark theme and clean light theme use restrained star glints, clear surfaces, and no fixed background attachment that can cause scroll repaint jank.
Primary calls to action and assistant controls are enlarged for mobile, assistant panel is constrained for narrow screens, and outside tap/click plus Escape dismiss the panel.
Seven sample demo identities have separate accent palettes and previous/all/next navigation.
Base site and bot styles are consolidated into a single versioned stylesheet to reduce one render-blocking CSS request per page; cache identifiers are rotated.

Windows deployment CMD invokes the PowerShell script from its own directory (no fragile quoted trailing-slash argument), validates repository and branch, checks for a clean tree, uses fast-forward-only pull, makes local and remote backups, asks before push, avoids force-push, and verifies GitHub main hash.
